reviews.title: Quality Product
reviews.comment:
Noise: 8/10
Instructions: 10/10
Accessories: 9/10
Quality: 10/10
I'm very happy with this product.  It's a bit noisier than I'd hoped, and it doesn't move as much air as I'd hoped, but overall a high quality product I'd buy again.

reviews.comment: i bought the wrong size but needed it until my new exhaust fan came. it was quiet and blew pretty hard
reviews.author: J. Hagee

reviews.title: They work.
reviews.comment: Fans are great. They make a bit of noise when running at 100% speed; noise is from the turbulence, though, not the fan parts.
reviews.author: D Tran

reviews.title: Fantastic Fan
reviews.comment: Awesome fan.  Quiet even at full RPM - and moves the perfect amount of air for my application. The color is historically horrid but it is a small price to pay for Noctua performance.
reviews.author: TL

reviews.title: Great quality, extremely loud.
reviews.comment: Bought this as an exhaust fan for a media cabinet. Could hear it over my home theater system. Exchanged it for one from a different brand with similar cfm that was whisper quiet. I love Noctua in my PC but this fan, without a low speed setting, is just way too loud.
reviews.author: Nathan Drake
